meaning_of_complete: Every assigned scientific document and relevant consequential obligation/source family assessed within finite declared research; not universal correctness, all possible alternatives or product execution.

axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.basis: All original obligations/negative constraints reviewed. Imported embedded-layer origin is materially incomplete (D-C02); identity, location honesty, deletion and optional-transcript boundaries otherwise covered.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.basis: Relevant definitions, defaults, code/callers/tests, versions, conditions and scoped histories reviewed. D-C01 is a material numeric language condition; D-C02 is a missing provenance condition.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.basis: Useful bounded PDF APIs, local OCR geometry, sidecar exclusions, dictionary/substring and conditional FTS5/Tantivy/semantic alternatives are preserved; histories are useful and scoped. No universal discovery recall claim.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.basis: Each released-plan clause and every authored criticism has an explicit and defensible disposition. SRT is honestly conditional; changelog access uncertainty is resolved through primary context. Undetected independent defects remain separately recorded.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.basis: Supported discovery/draft/critic meaning and stable source IDs are retained; transcript binding is added. No material supported meaning loss found. Carrying an erroneous fact is charged to accuracy, not invented preservation success.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.basis: Proposed fixtures have meaningful domains/oracles for versions, membership races, locations, malformed inputs and scripts. No parser/index/OCR, fixture or integration execution is claimed; upstream tests remain inspected source.

obligations_and_negative_constraints.basis: Incremental multilingual attachment scope and explicit unsupported/optional inputs are covered; tokenizer factual defect charged to axis 2.
Exact original opening and per-chunk provenance are substantial, but imported embedded OCR origin is not represented (D-C02).
Versioned page/shape/region/cue locators, coordinate frame and honest approximation/unavailability; timed transcript/audio association added.
Rename/move, profile changes, failed/cancelled replacement, membership deletion and late-worker fencing are coherent proposed rules.
Materially different retrieval/language/publication alternatives, coalescing and resource limits are compared. D-C01 limits source accuracy.
Local-only proposal and derivative/OCR caveats are explicit; no private upload or express OCR-fidelity claim. The origin omission is separately D-C02.
No precise unsupported locator is promised; membership/tombstone filtering explains deferred cleanup and suppresses deleted hits.
Audio transcription and unavailable-corpus accuracy are not made completion requirements; future recognition/relevance work is separated.

All requested fixture families and actual no-execution boundary.

validation_domains_oracles: Version/profile changes: only current eligible generation publishes; failed old jobs cannot relabel old content.
Shared deletion and late completion: only live membership yields hits, final tombstone prevents resurrection.
Locator tests: version-aware page/shape/cue, approximate/unknown and transformed OCR boxes; original opening checks bytes.
Retrieval fixtures: declared scripts/short queries/punctuation and expected passages, not unavailable-corpus accuracy.
Malformed/oversized/partial/cancel/timeout fixtures: typed errors, no premature destructive publication; explicit future dependency/runtime tests.
executed_candidate_validation: No parser/index/OCR/public-fixture/application tests claimed. Research and upstream test-source inspection only.
independent_execution: Hash/custody checks and Python UTF-8 example arithmetic; no third-party engine/test or future notebook deployment.
unassessed_outside_scope: Future runtime integration, corpus relevance/OCR quality and unchosen dependency packaging are not required executed validation.
Full native transcripts, private account identity, independent native-session linkage and provider/billing telemetry were unavailable and not sought.
